workload.name: TypeScript: opencode
workload.description: Cold clone, bun install and typecheck of anomalyco/opencode, at the commit and Bun version ComputeSDK's DAX sandbox benchmark uses. Unlike DAX, typecheck runs `turbo typecheck --concurrency=4` on every runner, whatever its size: turbo's default parallelism needs more than 16 GB and gets OOM-killed on runners without swap. Totals are therefore not directly comparable with DAX.
workload.toolchain: bun 1.3.14, node-gyp 13.0.2 on PATH (native modules built on every runner)

runners.label: ubuntu-24.04
runners.note: Standard 4 vCPU runner GitHub gives public repositories.

runners.label: github24-2cpu-x64
runners.note: GitHub 2-core larger runner (the size private repositories get as standard).

suiteNotes.node: 8 GB is not enough for the opencode typecheck, even with turbo limited to 4 tasks: TypeScript processes are killed out of memory (exit 137). 16 GB passes.

suiteSkips.docker: Not run: the PostHog Docker build needs more than 8 GB of memory; it ran out of memory on 8 GB runners.
